impact: AI-driven chip-equipment demand stays strong, a supportive read for memory capex and MU, DRAM and SNXX.
summary: Applied Materials reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $10.41B, up about 53% year over year, versus about $10.30B expected, and adjusted EPS of $4.16 versus about $4.06. It guided fiscal Q1 revenue to about $11.1B plus or minus $500M and EPS to $4.35, both above estimates of about $10.84B and $4.25. After-hours reaction was mixed, with reports ranging from a small dip to a roughly 3% gain after the stock closed down 3.58% at $380.95.
title: Applied Materials beats with record $10.41B revenue, guides Q1 to $11.1B
